_doc: Per-pitch level trims {track: {midi pitch: dB}} on legato notes (or every articulation: _all_arts / _all_arts_pitches); _skip_onsets keep none. c02 (critic B #4): per-pitch median residuals against each track's CC11 fit on c01 (single notes of 0.6 qn or more); the same deviations on the same patches in movement II. Clarinet 1 A flat 4 (the throat note) +5 (B: +6; kit LEARNINGS 13: +6 was too much at ff). c03 (critic B #2): the second players of shared patches (Horn 3 C5 +4.9 dB set the master peak at qn 637.8; Flute 2 Eb6/F6/G6 +9.7/+5.3/+9.4; Clarinet 2 Ab4 -5.3) and Cor anglais A4 +6.1, Tuba E2 +5.1. c04 (critic B #4): Trumpet 3 B3 +4 (4-5 dB under Trumpet 2 at ff/fff at the same onsets; the chord's B natural at bars 122-123). c07 (critic B #3): Clarinet 1 G5/A-flat5 trims on every articulation (Sus notes stood 5-9 dB over the line; bars 104-106 the loudest stem), B-flat5 -4; Cor anglais A-flat4 -4 and A4/A-flat4 on every articulation (Sus +9.8/+11 at qn 361/371).
